budget_items.topic: Dietary Aide starting wage and step
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Dietary Aide role is SAP Grade 2 and its initial steps sit below the Massachusetts minimum wage; the committee approved hiring at Grade 2 step 5 instead.
budget_items.quote: the initial steps are currently below the massachusetts minimum wage.

budget_items.topic: State minimum wage and SAP grid alternatives
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Asst. Town Manager presented salary grade alternatives so all starting wages meet the Massachusetts minimum wage, including reducing the SAP from 20 grade levels to 10.
budget_items.quote: she included additional alternatives to change the current sap which has 20 grade levels, down to only 10 grade levels.

budget_items.topic: Seasonal DPW Laborer/Truck Driver contracted work
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Temporary roles such as snow plowing, previously done by non-town employees with town equipment, are to become town employee roles because the state mandates town equipment be operated only by town employees.
budget_items.quote: the state mandates that utilizing town equipment can only be done by town employees.
